challenge.title: Two-step verification
challenge.intro: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app, or one of your recovery codes.

enrol.title: Set up two-step verification
enrol.intro: Staff and agency admins must protect their account with an authenticator app (for example Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator or 1Password).
enrol.introOptional: Protect your account with an authenticator app (for example Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator or 1Password).
enrol.scan: Scan this QR code with the app, or enter the key by hand:
enrol.qrAlt: QR code for your authenticator app
enrol.codesIntro: Each code works once, if you lose your phone. Store them somewhere safe — they will not be shown again.
enrol.passwordIntro: Confirm your password to start. This protects you if someone else is using your open session.

account.title: Security
account.required: Your role requires it, so it cannot be turned off.
account.codesLeft: {count, plural, =0 {No recovery codes left.} one {# recovery code left.} other {# recovery codes left.}}
account.regenerateIntro: Your old recovery codes stop working.
account.forgetIntro: Browsers you chose to remember skip the code for 30 days. Forget them all if you lost a device.

errors.invalid: That code is not valid. Check your app's time, or use a recovery code.
errors.input: Enter a 6-digit code or a recovery code (xxxxx-xxxxx).
errors.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Please wait a few minutes and try again.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
